name: code-teardown
description: Skills for working critically with code and with AI output: code-teardown (a static, evidence-backed verdict on code you did not write) and ai-evidence (scored evidence that an image was made or edited with AI).

plugins.name: code-teardown
plugins.description: Critical, evidence-backed teardown of source repos, .pyc files and Docker images.

plugins.name: ai-evidence
plugins.description: Weighs the evidence that an image was generated or edited with AI and reports scored evidence, not a verdict.
